samples.question: The top card is the REFERENCE. Each card has one cyan, magenta, green, and orange figure made from equal square tiles. For each color, count the exposed unit edges: a side shared by two same-color tiles is not exposed. Figures may move or turn. Which colored border encloses the option with exactly the same four color-to-perimeter counts as the reference? Answer red, blue, or gold.
